name: Pulpy Exotic Fizz #8
description:
A standard-sized can containing a carbonated beverage with shifting colors and flavors that mimic the fruit closest to the consumer. Consumed liquid grants the nutrition of a balanced meal.

EFFECT: Provides nutrition as if consuming a full meal.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Contents change color to match the nearest fruit.
TASTE: An intense, shifting fruit flavor that mimics the nearest fruit.
PACKAGING: A brightly colored can with tropical-themed graphics and large lettering advertising 'Pulpy Exotic Fizz.'

RESEARCHER NOTE: Great for those who can't decide between meal prep and a soda run.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-08-10 — edition #8 of the permanent record.
